pattern: if {e:DamageWould} , ( it | that source ) deals {m:DamageMore} instead

examples.text: If a blue source you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals triple that damage instead.
If another green source you control would deal damage to an opponent, it deals that much damage plus 3 to that player instead.

counterExamples: If a blue source you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals half that damage instead.
